text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: How to read: dot = name only, diamond = digit only; 3 dots per row = 3 prompt sets.

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: No cell fails the rule. Labelled = holds but stays above chance, far below digit only (86-89%).

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: Missing dots: control failed, too few items or not run. n = 16-300. Filled = hybrid, hollow = attention-only.
